text:
Release Bot: post-deploy synth smoke for rollout v2026.08.09 finished. Overall green but mobile SDK telem route had error spikes in apac-northeast. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/3823456789 :mag:
Diego: noticed ~1.6% 5xx from /mobile/sdk/poll in apac-northeast at 02:42UTC, mostly 502 bad-gateway. Small blast radius (5 hosts).
deploy-bot: synth-smoke: mobile-poll-check -> 502 upstream-reset hosts: 10.88.4.11..15 region=apac-northeast. Auto-retry queued.
QA Lead: grabbing synth logs, snippet:
```
POST /mobile/sdk/poll 502 {"error":"upstream-reset"} variant=v2026.08.09 cookie=client=ios trace=tr-3823-08-09-024242
```
mobile-eng: i'm on-call. Seeing backend pods recycle due to a new client-metrics agent that increases socket churn during startup. New agent registers long-lived sockets causing occasional race with kube-probe.
infra: confirmed node-level kube-probe flaps during a tight rollout window caused some established connections to reset. Not necessarily a code regression but interaction between the metrics agent and our liveness probes.
Diego: prefer targeted mitigation. Proposal: 1) pin /mobile/sdk/poll in apac-northeast to v2026.08.07 (previous stable) 2) disable the new metrics agent (feature flag: client_metrics_agent=false) on v2026.08.09 variant 3) re-run synth smoke. No full rollback.
deploy-bot: executing: redwood route pin --route /mobile/sdk/poll --to v2026.08.07 --region apac-northeast
deploy-bot: pin complete. Traffic now routed to v2026.08.07 in apac-northeast. :white_check_mark:
QA Lead: toggled client_metrics_agent=false on v2026.08.09 variant and kicked off synth rerun (id ss-3823456789-2).
deploy-bot: synth rerun complete: 200/200 checks OK, p95=128ms, no 5xx observed.
Diego: leaving pin for 20m to collect mobile-side error budgets and crash reports. If stable, gradually reintroduce the metrics agent with a 2% canary and delayed socket registration.
mobile-eng: opened INF-10350 "metrics agent socket registration race with liveness probe" and attached traces + device repro. Will add a startup backoff and update our kube-probe pacing guidance.
infra: also planning a short-term kube-probe grace increase during rolling updates of SDK backend to mitigate noisy restarts.
Release Bot: rollout hold set for 20m. Notifying #deploy-notify.
QA Lead: thanks team. Plan: after hold, reintroduce v2026.08.09 to /mobile/sdk/poll with client_metrics_agent=false, then run a slow ramp for agent variant once the startup backoff patch is merged. :thumbsup:
